raw_text: Seeing reports of a major ransomware attack on an Indian oil pipeline. Apparently SCADA systems are down and fuel distribution is halted in multiple states. Anyone have more details? This sounds like a Colonial Pipeline scenario. If confirmed, this would be one of the biggest cyber attacks on Indian critical infrastructure to date.
